cause: Safe JSON prior validator incorrectly applied an event-probability range to an unused non-event legacy summary. The signed-yard prior never uses that summary.
impact: No predictions were produced or published by the failed attempt. Numeric forest bytes survive. No prior experiment, method or label changed.
recovery: Validate training-only imputation, priors, and every tree leaf label/count against the exact hashed earlier-only training matrix. Reuse recovered numeric forest without repeating its fit. Preserve original unknown fit-cutoff clock; actual forecast issuance receives its own real clock.
